text: dsh-reveal-in-folder 是 DSH Web 插件，在文件链接、编辑器路径栏、侧边栏标签和图片上提供右键菜单。它通过客户端 contextmenu 事件识别路径，并由主机端按会话工作目录解析相对路径或文件名，再调用系统文件管理器定位文件。图片还可复制，远程图片可在浏览器打开。适合经常从 DSH 会话查看工作区文件的用户；不需要 API 密钥。

dsh-reveal-in-folder adds a context menu to DSH Web file links, editor paths, sidebar tabs, and images. It resolves files against session workspaces and opens them in the operating system file manager. You can also copy images or open remote images in a browser. No API key is required.
想从 DSH 对话里的文件链接直接在电脑文件管理器中定位文件
DSH 侧边栏标签只有文件名时，能不能帮我找到对应文件？
I want to right-click a DSH image and copy it or locate its local file.
dsh-reveal-in-folder 的功能「右键定位文件」：在 DSH Web 的文件引用、路径栏或侧边栏文件标签上右键，插件解析会话工作区中的路径并让系统文件管理器显示该文件；同名候选会列出供选择。
dsh-reveal-in-folder 的功能「图片快捷操作」：右键图片可复制为 PNG；本机附件图片还可定位到文件管理器，远程图片可选择在浏览器打开。

dsh-reveal-in-folder README · dsh-reveal-in-folder：[English](README.md) | [中文](README_zh.md)

Repository: https://github.com/haruri03/dsh-reveal-in-folder

Right-click a file path, an editor tab, or an image in the DSH Web UI and get the actions that are
actually available:

dsh-reveal-in-folder README · dsh-reveal-in-folder：Image coverage: images the agent posts in chat, the enlarged view, and sidebar image previews. When
an image has no DOM path, the client hashes its bytes with SHA-256 and matches the content-addressed
attachment object; that enables "Reveal in file manager". Remote images do not get that item.

dsh-reveal-in-folder README · Path resolution：Chat references and path bars often carry relative paths. If they are handed straight to the host,
`path.resolve` resolves them against the process cwd and opens the wrong directory. This plugin
resolves paths on the host instead:

dsh-reveal-in-folder README · Path resolution：Add `?dry=1` to resolve without opening:

```powershell
curl "http://127.0.0.1:<port>/reveal-in-folder?path=<relative-path>&dry=1"
```

dsh-reveal-in-folder README · Client behavior：- A capture-phase `contextmenu` listener takes over only when the value looks like a file: a single
  line with an extension; a value with a separator is treated as a path, a bare name as a tab label.
- The menu renders in `shell.overlay`, follows the cursor, and closes on Escape, an outside click, or
  scroll. Clicking an item closes the menu immediately and runs the action; unavailable actions are
  not shown, and failures close silently.
- Host routes use the Node `(req, res)` signature; DSH webServer routes are not Fetch handlers.
- Menu labels ship in Chinese and English and follow the host UI language; any other language shows
  English. Without the host client locale service the plugin reads `<html lang>`, and anything outside
  `zh*` shows English.

dsh-reveal-in-folder README · Install (manual)：Choose one:

**Human**: copy this directory to `$HOME/.dsh/profiles/<profile>/node_modules/dsh-reveal-in-folder`,
then append this row to the profile's `cordis.patch.yml`:

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: reveal-in-folder
      name: './index.js'
```

**Agent**: run `plugin_manager install_bundle --target "<path-to-plugin>"`.

dsh-reveal-in-folder README · Install from Git：When the repository root is the package (it contains `package.json` and `dsh.bundle`), install it
directly from its Git URL:

```powershell
plugin_manager install_bundle --target "git+https://github.com/haruri03/dsh-reveal-in-folder.git"
```

The same operation is available to humans through the Web plugin page ("Add plugin") or the CLI:

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add "git+https://github.com/haruri03/dsh-reveal-in-folder.git"
```

dsh-reveal-in-folder README · Install from Git：npm package names and tarball URLs are also accepted. To update, remove and reinstall, or wait for an
upstream release.

After installing or changing the client, **refresh the page once** (the browser caches client
modules).

dsh-reveal-in-folder README · Known limits：- Only **files** (with an extension) are recognized; right-clicking a directory does not open a menu.
- When a tab exposes only a file name and the repository contains several files with that name, the
  menu lists the candidates to choose from (sorted by path depth, up to 100 entries, scrollable).
  Right-sidebar tabs that carry `data-sidebar-right-session` are searched inside that session's
  workspace first.
- Tab-only filenames use a bounded search (20k entries / 8 levels); in very large repositories the
  action may fail and is then not shown.
